simple_statement: Same or near-identical grade to the last cargo — load directly. No cleaning or draining needed.
procedure_steps: 1. No action required — load as is.
original_instruction_1: The grade to be loaded is identical or nearly identical to the previous cargo and no additional cleaning or draining is required.

simple_statement: Previous cargo is acceptable — just drain the tanks and lines well before loading. No washing.
procedure_steps:
1. Well drain cargo tank, pump columns and pipe lines using the ship's stripping system.
2. Keep any ROB only in the pump well (where fitted).
3. Clear and drain pump columns, pipe lines and drops of all free product and water.
4. Ensure ROB does not exceed 0.05% of individual tank capacity.
original_instruction_1: Previous cargo is acceptable, so long as the cargo tank, pump columns and pipe lines are "Well Drained" by the ship's stripping system to minimise the ROB - any ROB that does remain should only ever be in the pump well, where fitted. Pump columns, pipe lines and drops should be cleared and drained free of all free-standing product and water. An ROB volume in excess of 0.05% of the Individual Tank capacity does not meet the well drained criteria.

simple_statement: Well drain, then cold sea-water machine wash; flush lines and drain.
procedure_steps:
1. Well drain tank, pump columns and pipe lines (minimise ROB).
2. Machine wash the tank with cold sea water.
3. Water flush the lines.
4. Drain tank and lines of all free water/product.
original_instruction_1: On discharge, ensure that the cargo tank, pump columns and pipelines are "Well Drained" by the ship's stripping system to minimise the ROB then the cargo tank(s) are to be machine washed using cold sea-water, lines water flushed and both tank and lines drained well to remove all free-standing water/product.
